capabilities: Sync vault files and settings across devices through a Seafile server
Merge independent edits automatically and preserve conflict copies
Browse version history and restore file or vault snapshots
Diagnose and repair sync problems with verification and index rebuild tools
extras: README warns of data corruption or loss risk while the plugin is under development and advises keeping backups; files over 50 MB may be slow or memory-intensive on mobile.
intentEvidence: This repository is a maintained fork of ryanravn/obsidian-seafile-continued
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid hosted service, and Seafile users lack a native way to sync their vault through their own self-hosted Seafile server.

relations.evidence: This repository is a maintained fork of ryanravn/obsidian-seafile-continued
Original plugin by @conql. The continued version was created and is maintained upstream by @ryanravn.
synchronizing notes across devices using Seafile, an open-source, self-hosted file sync and share solution

requires.name: Seafile account (password, SSO, or API token)

summary: Seafile-based sync plugin that synchronizes vault files and settings across devices via a self-hosted Seafile server, with realtime sync, conflict merging, and version history.
